== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
The early slip requires the affected character to be forfeited for zero at battle end. The remastered slip loses that character at battle end and specifies zero if forfeited. Both retain the Goo Nee Tay threshold and Alter immunity. The later slip adds a printed bullet. The original virtual-card rule inherits the underlying unique card’s restriction.
